newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Gulf Petrochemical Industries Co cuts dividend.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Petrochemical Industries Co cuts dividend.

text.p: Gulf Petrochemical Industries Co (GPIC) said on Monday it would pay a total $15 million dividend to shareholders for 1996, after distributing $30 million for 1995.
The Bahrain-based company announced earlier that its 1996 operating income dropped 42.2 percent to $52 million from $90 million in 1995.
GPIC is owned by the Bahrain National Oil Co, Saudi Arabia's industrial giant Saudi Basic Industries Corp and Kuwait's Petrochemical Industries Co.
It signed a $136 million contract in 1995 with Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd to build a 1,700-tonne per day urea plant and associated facilities in Bahrain.
